name: Wuhan Lincontrol Automotive Electronics Co., Ltd.
summary: Wuhan Lincontrol Automotive Electronics Co., Ltd. engages in the development and manufacturing of engine management system and new energy vehicle power electronics control system products in China and internationally. The company offers gasoline direct injection, dual-fuel, motorcycle, and port fuel injection engine management system; double motor, EV/hybrid vehicle, electric machine, and generator controller, as well as EMS hybrid EMS; intelligent vehicle-mounted terminal; and CNG/LNG rail regulator, orifice disk, and injector.
